en: A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large Renaissance-style castle surrounded by trees and a moat. The building has multiple towers with spires and flagpoles on the roof. At the lower part of the image and into the margin there is dense handwritten script. In the bottom left corner small printed text identifies the place, and in the bottom right corner another printed word appears, likely the name of the castle or town.
